description: Create Angular API services for every backend domain and wire the Dashboard (filing wizard) and Filer Details pages to real API calls, removing all dummy in-memory data from those components. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend must compile). Independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004.
steps:
Step 1 — Create the Angular API service layer. Create D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\core\api\api.config.ts that exports: export const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:8080'. Create one service file per backend domain in D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\core\api\:
  - filer.service.ts: @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }). Inject HttpClient. Methods return Observable<T>: getAll(): Observable<TaxseerFiler[]>, search(q: string): Observable<TaxseerFiler[]> — uses ?q=queryParam on GET /api/filers, getById(id: number): Observable<TaxseerFiler>, create(f: TaxseerFiler): Observable<TaxseerFiler>, update(id: number, f: TaxseerFiler): Observable<TaxseerFiler>, delete(id: number): Observable<void>.
  - recipient.service.ts: getByFiler(filerId: number): Observable<FilerRecipient[]>, search(filerId: number, q: string): Observable<FilerRecipient[]> — GET /api/recipients?filerId=&q=, getById(id: number), create(r), update(id, r), delete(id).
  - filing.service.ts: getByFiler(filerId: number, taxYear?: number, status?: string): Observable<FilerFiling[]> — GET /api/filings?filerId=&taxYear=&status=, getById(id), create(f), update(id, f), updateStatus(id, status): Observable<FilerFiling>, delete(id).
  - order.service.ts: getAll(params?: {status?: string, q?: string, filerId?: number}): Observable<TaxseerOrder[]>, getById(id: string).
  - cart.service.ts: getCart(userId: number): Observable<any[]>, addToCart(filingId: number, userId: number), removeFromCart(id: number), checkout(userId: number).
  - w9.service.ts: getByFiler(filerId: number), sendRequest(recipientId: number, filerId: number), remind(id: number), markReceived(id: number).
  - download.service.ts: getByFiler(filerId: number), create(download: any).
  - user.service.ts: getAll(), getById(id), create(u), update(id, u), delete(id), resendInvite(id).
  - role.service.ts: getAll(), update(id, r).
  - wallet.service.ts: getBalance(userId: number), addFunds(userId: number, amount: number).
  Import relevant types from the existing data files (TaxseerFiler from taxseer-filers.data.ts; FilerRecipient, FilerFiling, FilerDownload from filer-details.data.ts; TaxseerOrder from orders.data.ts).

Step 2 — Provide HttpClient in the Angular app. Open D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\app.config.ts and add provideHttpClient(withFetch()) to the providers array. Import provideHttpClient and withFetch from @angular/common/http.

Step 3 — Wire the Dashboard component (D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\views\taxseer\pages\dashboard\dashboard.ts) to FilerService and RecipientService.
  - Inject FilerService and RecipientService.
  - Replace the readonly `filers: Filer[]` in-memory array with a public `filers: Filer[] = []` and load it in ngOnInit (or constructor) via filerService.getAll().subscribe(data => this.filers = data).
  - Replace the `recipients: Recipient[]` in-memory array with `recipients: Recipient[] = []` and load it after filer is selected via recipientService.getByFiler(this.selectedFilerId!).subscribe(data => this.recipients = data).
  - For filer search: when filerSearch changes, call filerService.search(q).subscribe(...) if q is non-empty, else filerService.getAll().subscribe(...).
  - Keep all UI logic (wizard steps, amountRows, bulkRows, stepSummary, canReach, etc.) exactly as-is — only replace the data source.
  - DO NOT touch dashboard.html.

Step 4 — Wire the Filer Details component (D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\views\taxseer\pages\filer-details\filer-details.ts).
  - Inject FilerService, RecipientService, FilingService, DownloadService.
  - Replace usages of FILER_RECIPIENTS, FILER_FILINGS, FILER_DOWNLOADS (imported from filer-details.data.ts) with reactive loads: when routeId changes, call recipientService.getByFiler(id).subscribe(data => ...), filingService.getByFiler(id, selectedYear).subscribe(data => ...), downloadService.getByFiler(id).subscribe(data => ...).
  - For the filer profile itself, replace store.getById(id) with filerService.getById(id).subscribe(f => this.filer = f).
  - Save filer changes via filerService.update(id, filer).subscribe(...).
  - Keep TaxseerFilerStore in place for the nav list but load the store from API on init if the store is empty (optional optimisation — priority is correctness, not eliminating the store entirely).
  - DO NOT touch filer-details.html.
Step 5 — Verify: run `npm run build` from D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse- and confirm no TypeScript compilation errors.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` from D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse- exits with no TypeScript errors
All 10 Angular service files exist under src/app/core/api/
Dashboard no longer has hard-coded readonly Filer[] or Recipient[] arrays — data comes from service calls
Filer Details no longer imports FILER_RECIPIENTS, FILER_FILINGS, FILER_DOWNLOADS as static arrays — data is loaded via services
No CSS, SCSS, or HTML files are modified
verification: Run `npm run build` from D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse- — expect zero TypeScript errors
With backend running, open http://localhost:4200/taxseer/dashboard — filers list should render from API (or empty if DB is empty)
findings: 10 Angular services created under src/app/core/api/ (filer, recipient, filing, order, cart, w9, download, user, role, wallet). app.config.ts updated to provideHttpClient(withFetch()). Dashboard wired: readonly filers/recipients arrays replaced with API-loaded mutable arrays via FilerService and RecipientService; ngOnInit loads filers on startup; chooseFiler() and startFiling() trigger loadRecipients(). FilerDetails wired: FILER_RECIPIENTS/FILER_FILINGS/FILER_DOWNLOADS static initializers removed; an effect() reacts to routeId signal changes and calls filerService.getById(), recipientService.getByFiler(), filingService.getByFiler(), downloadService.getByFiler(); saveEdit() now calls filerService.update(). filer computed signal replaced with writable filerData signal. No CSS/HTML files touched. Build: npm run build exits with zero errors.
